trigger: The child leaves a segment, or the lesson ends on it. depthShown says which text version was actually on screen - standard, simplified or expanded - on every segment, not only the ones an adaptation touched. Design D23, ask B45.
The child plays a finished piece of media again from the start. Use this for a narration restart too, rather than narration_replayed, so one restart is not counted twice.
The child scrolls within a segment.
The child asks for the simpler wording.
The child asks for the fuller wording.
The child asks for a slower pace.
The child answers a comprehension checkpoint. Correctness is not sent: it is decided on the server against the stored answer.
The child tries to leave mid-lesson.
Nevo offered a break.
The child accepted an offered break.
The child refused an offered break. Without this the engine cannot tell "not now" from no answer and may offer again a minute later.
A break actually began.
A break ended. With break_start this is how long it lasted, which is the part that says whether it helped.
The child answers the consolidation break's question about how they are getting on.
The child reaches the end of a module.
What they chose there.
A reading the named types do not already cover. The type of last resort: the engine can reason about a named type and can only count these.
Nevo offered a different modality.
The child took the offer.
The child refused it.
The offer was shown and neither taken nor refused before the child moved on.
Sent once when the next segment entered in the new modality is left or completed. That entry-to-exit interval is a full segment; it has no minimum number of seconds. One per switch. Ask B38.
The child changed modality themselves, with nothing offered.
The child answers one step of a calculation.
The child finishes a calculation.
Narration starts for the first time on a segment.
Reserved. Send replay for a restart instead, so one restart is not counted under two types. Ask B39.
The child places a draggable piece.
A child asks Nevo a question, on an ask_nevo session.
A teacher asks Nevo a question.
Ask Nevo declined to answer and handed the asker on.
The asker followed where it sent them.
Server-written. An adaptation was decided and then held back by a rate limit or a cooldown. Clients do not send this.
A picture or a recording did not load. reason is one of offline, refresh_failed, load_error.
The system owned the wait, not the child - audio playing, a dialog open, a transition running. Counted as idle time until this existed.
A tap the interface refused because something was loading or disabled. Repeated refused taps are a child trying, which reads as a child doing nothing unless it is reported.
Once per session, first. Dwell times on a phone are not dwell times on a desktop, and a child with reduced motion on is not a child ignoring an animation.
A stable reading chunk entered view or was passed. A later entered event after passed is a reread; formFactor keeps scrolling patterns comparable.
A baseline module begins.
A baseline module finishes.
The baseline is submitted. With the two above, an abandoned baseline can be told from one never started.
Nevo offered a hint, whether or not the child asked for one.
The child acted on a hint: opened one they had to open, or moved on after one shown in full. A hint shown and ignored is hint_offered alone. Ask B41.
Nevo offered harder work.
The child took it.
The child refused it.
A guided question was put to the child.
Server-written by POST /api/intelligence/guided-questions/answer. Clients do not send this, or one reply would count twice. Ask B41.
